status_summary: NFL betting analytics dashboard, now in preseason (season starts 2026-09-08). This run (2026-08-23, session number not visible from this repo -- see note on session_log entry below) fixed the Futures Intel Report page end to end: (1) restored report interactivity (missing iframe sandbox flag -- prior fix, already synced), (2) found and backfilled a major data gap -- futures_odds_snapshots held only an automated superbowl-only feed; ~3 months of manually-gathered BetOnline/Bookmaker/BetUS futures data (19 batch files, 4,333 rows) had never been loaded, which is why Line Movement and Value Spots were thin -- backfill ran live, verified 8,685 rows across all 8 report categories, (3) fixed a display bug where a Value Spot card showed only the point gap between two books' prices (e.g. "+227") instead of the worse book's actual price, which read as corrupted/truncated data, (4) found and fixed why Expert Signals wasn't surfacing picks stated in article bodies -- pick extraction only ever read the short RSS teaser, never the full article text a separate step was already fetching, (5) fixed the report's tab-nav so clicking a category actually scrolls the page. Yahoo Fantasy API access status not re-checked this session -- alert below left as-is.
